pages.text: Inspired by the eerie Abyssal forces of Kantai Collection, the $(l)Destroyer Pity$() is a formidable aquatic toy. She thrives in the deep, striking terror into her foes from the waves.

pages.title: Combat Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 50$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 15$(li)$(6)Damage:$() 7.5$(br2)Special technique: $(b)Perfect Swimmer$(). When submerged in water, her attacks become devastating. You can restore her health by feeding her $(b)Cookies$(), though they are quite rare to find.
